Q6113.reason: Common-law arson requires malice (intent or reckless disregard of an obvious fire risk), and merely forgetting to turn off the stove does not meet that mental state.

Q5966.reason: The cardiac cycle is the alternation of diastole and systole, with no separate named rest phase in the standard definition.

Q8294.reason: Ice is less dense than liquid water because hydrogen bonds hold it in an open crystalline lattice, so pressure favors the denser liquid and the solid-liquid line slopes negatively.
